A1.content:
I offer a wide range of tools and capabilities to assist with data analysis, task planning, and HR management. You have access to various workspaces and tools, including **AI Workspace** for assisted analysis and **People & Payroll** for managing HR-related tasks like payroll, attendance, and leave. Additionally, I can execute Python code, plan and manage tasks, create data-quality rules, and more. Below is a detailed list of my capabilities and accessible workspaces to support your needs. ### Accessible Workspaces | Workspace | Description | Route |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI Workspace | Use the AI workspace for assisted analysis. | /carbon/console |
| People & Payroll | Manage employees, payroll runs, leave, loans, attendance and GOSI/WPS. | /people | ### Agent Capabilities | Capability | Description | Requires Confirmation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run Python Code | I can run Python/pandas code over a result set to compute tables and charts. | No |
| Create Data-Quality Rule | Propose and create a data-quality (DQ) rule. | Yes |
| Cross-Synthesize Results | Combine results already retrieved from multiple domains into one answer. | No |
| List Capabilities | List the work areas, apps and pages the current user can access. | No |
| Plan Tasks | Turn a task brief into a reviewable execution plan. | No |
| Edit Plans | Revise an existing plan based on the user's chat feedback. | No |
| Approve Plans | Approve the settled plan and convert it into a real runnable task. | No |
| Web Research | Search the web for real-time information including news, weather, and exchange rates. | No |
| Export Documents | Generate downloadable Word or Excel documents from findings. | No |
| Save Work Objective | Save the current investigation objective for later resumption. | No |
| Retrieve Work Objectives | Retrieve the user's saved work objectives. | No |
| Unit Conversion | I can convert between common units (length, mass, temperature, volume). | No |
